data.value: Will the residents' petition against the Riverton quarry extension collect the 1,500 signatures needed to trigger a council debate before the submission deadline in six weeks?

The town has 19,000 residents. The quarry extension is a local issue. The petition needs 1,500 signatures to trigger a council debate. The submission deadline is in six weeks from the start time (2026-09-14T17:00:00-06:00). The organizers have 400 signatures so far. The quarry operator distributed a counter-flyer last week.
